task_definition.task_name: Magnitude Estimation using MagNet on STEAD

task_description.overview: Estimate earthquake magnitudes directly from raw single-station waveform data using the MagNet deep learning model and compare with ground truth magnitudes.
steps: Load the pretrained MagNet model with specified input channels and sample length.
Load the raw waveform data from the STEAD dataset (.npz file).
Normalize each component of the waveform data using the chosen normalization mode (e.g., 'std').
Convert the normalized data to a tensor and perform inference with the MagNet model to obtain predicted magnitudes and uncertainties.
Load the ground truth magnitudes from the provided CSV file.
Compare predicted magnitudes with ground truth by computing statistics or plotting a 1:1 scatter plot.

task_definition.agent_prompt:
Perform magnitude estimation on the 3-component seismic dataset (STEAD) using `magnet` deep learning model. Load and normalize the seismic data from {data_path} with the specific {normalize_mode} mode. The pretrained magnet model is located at {pretrained_model_path}, and its related parameters are {model_params}. 
 (1) Run inference and save the magnitude estimation results into a csv file. 
 (2) Load the target magnitude from {target_path} by reading the columns `source_magnitude`. 
 (3) Plot one figure showing the magnitude estimation results and the target magnitude. The result data should be saved to {result_data.save_name} with content {result_data.content}, and the result figure should be saved to {result_figure}.
